originally thought it was OK in the specific situation of this driver

column1: context prints a big fat warning when CONFIG_DEBUG_PREEMPT=y.

column2: this commit replaces the smp_processor_id() in

column1: migration-enabled contexts by the appropriate get_cpu/put_cpu sections.
